answer: AI-agent grids tracking marble freight, ferrous smelting, or exhaust plume sensors can curb Sybil floods via Proof of Replication. Each agent seals a unique sector bound to its public key using a slow sequential hash graph, then answers random Merkle challenges before a strict timeout. Since re-encoding on demand misses the deadline, attackers must dedicate non-deduplicable disk storage and I/O per identity. Still, bulk storage costs less at datacenter scale, favoring large cloud operators.
